verdicts.reason: A: the legal text sits at the far left and is about the same size as the secondary copy, so the banner opens on fine print. The LONGEST DAY SALE ribbon is shrunk to an unreadable tag that collides with the edge of the phone. Still, the headline, '25% off' line and CTA read left to right in a clean block. B: the '25% off on June 21' line is crammed into a narrow column and broken across four lines. The sale ribbon and logo are jammed into the top-left corner at a size you can't read, and the legal text below them is illegible, so B's typography and grouping are worse.
